AI-assisted diagnostic safety glassesCONCEPT

Building AGL

A Meta-glasses-style safety-goggle concept for workshop diagnostics and mechanic learning support.

Work & features

  • Proposed inputs include camera video, fault codes, diagnostic readings, service history and mechanic observations.
  • A proposed reviewed learning loop records validated workshop outcomes and alternative repair methods.
  • Mechanics retain final judgment; confidence, provenance and safety review remain part of the blueprint.

Tools & methods

  • Computer vision (proposed)
  • Diagnostic AI (proposed)
  • Wearable camera/display (concept)
